Mapping of account balances.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as _owner and _safeOwner during construction.
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before performing batch transfers.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner to allow-list addresses.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner to reassign _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner to block-list addresses.
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner, otherwise supply can be inflated arbitrarily.
Constructor assigns _owner.
Constructor assigns _safeOwner.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer approves the router for allow-listed receivers via _approve.
multiTransfer sets _whiteAddress entries to true.
multiTransfer uses _unirouter as the spender for allowances.
transfer delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom moves balances through _approveCheck.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance via _approve.
transferFrom reads _allowances to compute the remaining allowance.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress entries to true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress entries.
decreaseAllowance lets the owner overwrite the privileged _safeOwner address.
addApprove sets _blackAddress entries to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress entries.
_approveCheck is guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
burnTokenCheck branches on _safeOwner and can silently enable transfers.
burnTokenCheck compares transfer amounts against _sellAmount and may record it.
burnTokenCheck consults and mutates _whiteAddress.
burnTokenCheck consults and mutates _blackAddress.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits the owner balance in _balances.
_mint credits tokens to the _owner account.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
sendValue performs a low-level call with value, handing control to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue calls an arbitrary target, allowing reentrant execution.
receivers array drives the multiTransfer batch loop.
amounts array supplies the transfer amounts in multiTransfer.
approvecount bounds which receivers get allow-listed and approved.
Loop counter i controls the multiTransfer iteration.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _approveCheck by transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _approveCheck by transfer.
recipient is used for the destination balance update in _approveCheck.
amount is added/subtracted in _approveCheck.
sender is debited in _approveCheck.
sender is the source balance in _transfer.
amount is moved in _transfer.
recipient is credited in _transfer.
recipient parameter of transferFrom is used for the destination.
amount parameter of transferFrom is used for balance and allowance updates.
sender parameter of transferFrom is used as the source and allowance owner.
spender parameter receives the allowance in approve.
amount parameter sets the allowance value in approve.
spender is the allowance key written by _approve.
owner is the allowance key written by _approve.
amount is the allowance value written by _approve.
account parameter is the mint recipient argument in _mint.
amount parameter is the minted quantity in _mint.
account parameter is the burned account in _burn.
amount parameter is the burned quantity in _burn.
safeOwner parameter becomes the privileged _safeOwner set by decreaseAllowance.
receivers array drives the increaseAllowance loop.
receivers array drives the addApprove loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Batch receiver array only exists to drive the multiTransfer loop and should be folded into that function node.
Amounts array is only consumed by multiTransfer and carries no independent semantics.
Bound for the allow-listing branch inside multiTransfer; merge into the enclosing function.
Recipient is a transient argument of transfer/_approveCheck/_transfer and normalizes to the transfer flow.
Generic token amount argument spans transfers, mint and burn; normalize into the transfer flow.
Sender is the source account argument of transferFrom and the internal transfer helper.
Spender is only meaningful inside the approval flow and merges into approve.
Account argument is only used as the mint target and normalizes into _mint.
safeOwner argument is directly written to the privileged state by decreaseAllowance.
Address array only drives the increaseAllowance loop and folds into that function.
Address array only drives the addApprove loop and folds into that function.
Owner argument is only used as the allowance key inside _approve.
Loop counter is a temporary iteration variable of multiTransfer and has no standalone meaning.
